scope: Only the six user-reported UI/flow issues
changes: Admin-selected agent is explicitly assigned to the created chit.
Agent dashboard merges the authoritative chit list so assigned chits appear in My assigned chits.
Draft chit detail exposes Setup & Publish.
Fixed Draw interest is hidden until a draw/interest window is actually opened.
Fixed Draw exposes Open and Run controls in the correct lifecycle.
Auction exposes Open, Close and Finalize controls; member bidding is hidden until auction is open.
